html:
Unique Research · Insight / industry map · February 21, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub

ChatGPT (Dec 2022) shocked with dialogue + novel/script drafting — even graded A+ as “best paper” at Northern Michigan University. Follow-on to Unique Research’s prior AIGC×content-marketing essay; this Map 1.0 surveys China players across text / image / video / audio / digital human / games / general / models.

Frame. AIGC = AI Generated Content. First AI painting sold for ¥3M (GAN, 2018). Copy.ai hit $10M+ ARR in ~2 years — mobile-internet-like speed. Compute + data + algorithms compound; commercial modes still forming. China map layers by modality.

Text (sample). Langboat (Mencius LM; Panda Novelist mini-program; Zhou Ming); ColorfulClouds Xiaomeng AI novel-writer (Yuan Xingyuan — “extend life via free roleplay”); BeYou / YOO Resume on Wernicke / WCCG writing engine; KAWO social-media collab SaaS (save 3–4 hrs/week); Xiangnong Tech AI+finance research; Giiso editors; Meta Network; Emotibot-class dialogue stacks.

Image / video / audio. Tiamat generative image; Meitu; Wondershare (film/cast/AI tools); ZMO; FancyTech cross-platform ecom data+AI; Jingying Tech; audio stacks (Daoying Yousheng, DeepMusic-class AI compose). Live/short-video script tools for ecom hosts.

Digital humans / XR / games. Yilan Tech Meta Conference / Meta Streaming XR; Aihuashen-class photoreal; game labs (Tencent AI Lab, IEG × Honor of Kings AI); NetEase Fuxi peers.

Models & infra. OpenAI reference; BAAI FlagAI; Zhipu / WuDao lineage; Meta AI; NGC-class stacks. Full named roster lives on CN map images (many dozens).

Map images carry complete company list — attach on ingest. Methodology/disclaimer §10.

— END —
